name: normaliseWithMissingHtmlHeadBody
input: Document created with baseUri 'http://example.com' containing raw text and no html/head/body structure
expected: Should ensure <html>, <head>, and <body> elements exist and move stray root text nodes into the body element.

name: normaliseWithBlankTextNodesInRoot
input: Document containing whitespace-only text nodes at the root level
expected: Should ignore blank text nodes and not move them into the body element, per normaliseTextNodes condition (!tn.isBlank()).

name: normaliseWithMultipleHeadElements
input: Document structure containing multiple <head> elements under <html>
expected: normaliseStructure should merge duplicate <head> child nodes into the first <head> and remove the duplicate elements.

name: normaliseWithMultipleBodyElements
expected: normaliseStructure should merge duplicate <body> child nodes into the first <body> and remove the duplicate elements.

name: normaliseWithHeadNotParentedByHtml
input: Document where the <head> element is parented by an element other than <html>
expected: normaliseStructure should re-parent the master <head> element under the <html> element.

name: normaliseWithBodyNotParentedByHtml
input: Document where the <body> element is parented by an element other than <html>
expected: normaliseStructure should re-parent the master <body> element under the <html> element.

name: normaliseTextNodesInHead
input: Document with non-blank text nodes directly inside the <head> element
expected: Should extract text nodes from <head> and prepend them into the <body> element in correct order.

name: normaliseTextNodesInHtml
input: Document with non-blank text nodes directly inside the <html> element
expected: Should extract text nodes from <html> and prepend them into the <body> element.

name: normaliseAlreadyNormalisedDocument
expected: Should return the document unchanged as structural elements (html, head, body) are already correctly placed and empty of stray text.

name: normaliseStructureWithSingleElement
input: A single matching tag element already correctly parented by htmlEl
expected: Should leave the element untouched since there are no duplicates and parent is correct.

name: normaliseStructureWithDuplicateElementsAndOrphanParent
input: Multiple elements matching the tag with one parented elsewhere and children present
expected: Should collect all child nodes from duplicates, remove duplicates, append children to master, and append master to htmlEl.
